name: fitweb-gate-v6-1
prompt: Edit this image and keep the camera, framing, scale model style, colours and soft light exactly the same. Keep these exactly as they are: the gate canopy and everything at the gate (guard block, glass cabin, FIT logo, plaque, Forteasia pillar and logo, canopy lettering, the single boom barrier, flags, grass, workers, trucks, pickup, forklift), the wide main road in the foreground with its T-junction, and the straight township road with its green median and trees running from the gate into the far distance. Change ONLY the two buildings so the layout is logical, as in a real industrial park where every unit faces the road it is accessed from: 1) The FACTORY on the LEFT of the township road: turn it so its long main facade, with the loading-bay doors (one open with warm light), the office block entrance and the truck yard, faces the township road on its right. Put a paved forecourt and truck yard between the factory facade and the road, with a wide driveway joining the road through a gap in the kerb. A truck backed into a bay facing the road, a forklift, pallets and workers in the yard. 2) The WAREHOUSE on the RIGHT of the township road: turn it so its long facade with the row of loading docks faces the township road on its left. Paved truck yard between the docks and the road, with a wide driveway joining the road. A container truck at a dock, a forklift, pallets and workers. Both buildings stand parallel to the township road, set back by their yards, at the same scale as now, firmly on the ground. Keep exactly one factory and one warehouse, nothing else. No new text or logos, no watermark.
